claim_text: The January 24, 2024 Mohamed indictment, No. 0:24-cr-00015 (ECF 1) para 12, recites that Feeding Our Future went from receiving and disbursing approximately $3.4 million in federal funds to sites under its sponsorship in 2019 to nearly $200 million in 2021, and para 14 recites that Feeding Our Future received nearly $18 million in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds as administrative fees in 2021. These are FOF-sponsor-wide recitals (amount_paid), not the Mohamed family's alleged loss. They overlap the Bock $250 million charging headline (overlap_group_id fof-network-scheme-size) and must not be added to that headline, to the Mohamed >$12 million figure, or to HSS.
